backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing video/photo sharing platform with user profiles, channels, subscriptions, comments, likes, playlists, and access control using Motoko mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features for the VideoPlayer page including HTML5 player, title display, subscribe button, expandable description, comments section, and related videos sidebar.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and styling, describing a YouTube-style media platform with video/photo upload, galleries, player pages, and authentication.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode themes with YouTube-style dark backgrounds and design tokens for the media platform.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the MediaShare application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, video/photo galleries, upload pages, player pages, settings, channel profiles, and upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistMod: Empty file placeholder for a modal component to add videos to playlists.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Authentication button component integrating Internet Identity with dropdown menu showing user principal and sign in/out functionality with loading states.
frontend/src/components/ChannelNameDispl: Component displaying channel name as a clickable link to channel profile, fetching name via useChannelName hook with loading skeleton and truncated principal fallback.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Displays a comment section for videos with a form to add new comments (authenticated users only) and a list of existing comments with author avatars, channel names, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header (logo, search bar, upload button, auth), collapsible sidebar, main content area, and footer with social links and quick navigation.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCard.tsx: Displays a photo card with thumbnail, title, uploader channel name, and upload date; navigates to photo detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to enter their name (required) and optional channel name (3-30 characters) on first login.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Responsive sidebar navigation with Home, Trending (disabled), and Library (disabled) links; includes mobile overlay and close button.
frontend/src/components/TagInput.tsx: Tag input component allowing users to add tags by pressing Enter or comma, remove tags with X button, and displays tags as badges.
frontend/src/components/ThumbnailSelecto: Allows users to select a video thumbnail by either choosing from auto-generated frames at 10%, 30%, 50%, 70% positions or uploading a custom image (JPEG/PNG, max 5MB).
frontend/src/components/UpgradePrompt.ts: A promotional card component that displays premium subscription benefits (unlimited uploads, 4K quality, priority support) to free-tier users and navigates to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Displays video metadata in either default or compact card layouts with thumbnail, title, channel name, view count, and upload time; navigates to video detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/VideoEditModal.t: A modal dialog with tabs for editing video details (title, description, tags) and managing thumbnails; includes save functionality and change tracking.
frontend/src/components/VideoQualitySele: A dropdown menu component for selecting video playback quality (auto, 360p-1080p) with a note about browser and source limitations.
frontend/src/components/VideoSettings.ts: Manages video thumbnail settings with options to add, change, or remove thumbnails; displays current thumbnail and integrates ThumbnailSelector component.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: Mutation hook for adding comments to videos; invalidates related queries on success and shows authentication error if user is not signed in.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddVideoToPlaylist: Empty file placeholder for adding videos to playlists functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useChannelName.ts: Query hook that fetches and caches channel names by principal ID with 5-minute stale time.
frontend/src/hooks/useComments.ts: Query hook that fetches comments for a specific video ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreatePlaylist.ts: Empty file placeholder for playlist creation functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile with custom loading state that accounts for actor initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserSubscriptio: Query hook that returns user subscription tier and features; currently returns free tier as default with a TODO for backend integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useIncrementPhotoView: Empty file placeholder for photo view count increment functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useIncrementVideoView: Mutation hook that increments video view count and invalidates related queries; silently handles errors to avoid disrupting user experience.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarkThumbnailGener: Mutation hook to mark a video thumbnail as generated by calling the backend actor and invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhoto.ts: Query hook to fetch a single photo by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotos.ts: Query hook to fetch a list of all photo metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoUpload.ts: Mutation hook for uploading photos with progress tracking, converting File to Uint8Array and calling the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaylist.ts: Empty file placeholder for playlist-related functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaylists.ts: Empty file placeholder for playlists-related functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useRemoveThumbnail.ts: Mutation hook to remove a video thumbnail via the backend actor with authorization error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useRemoveVideoFromPla: Empty file placeholder for removing videos from playlists.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Mutation hook to save the current user's profile and invalidate related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchVideos.ts: Query hook to search videos by term, fetching metadata and full video data for each result.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetChannelName.ts: Mutation hook to set a channel name with validation (3-30 characters) and appropriate error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetCustomThumbnail: Mutation hook to upload a custom thumbnail for a video with progress tracking via ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscribe.ts: Mutation hook placeholder for channel subscription functionality that throws 'coming soon' error.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionStatus: Query hook placeholder for checking subscription status that returns false until backend is implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateVideo.ts: Mutation hook to update video metadata (title, description, tags) with authorization checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpgradeAccount.ts: Mutation hook placeholder for account upgrade functionality that simulates delay then throws not-implemented error.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: Query hook to fetch user statistics by principal with 5-minute cache staleness.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.ts: Query hook to fetch a single extended video by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoLike.ts: Mutation hook to like a video with duplicate-like detection and authentication error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideos.ts: Query hook to fetch a list of all video metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts: Mutation hook for uploading videos with progress tracking, converting File to ExternalBlob, and categorized error handling (authentication, network, conversion, backend).
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelProfile.tsx: Displays a user's channel profile page showing their uploaded videos and photos, channel statistics, and account information based on principal ID from URL params.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component that displays a grid of all videos with loading states and empty state messaging.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoGallery.tsx: Photo gallery page with search functionality that displays all photos in a responsive grid layout with debounced search filtering.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoViewer.tsx: Individual photo viewer page that displays a single photo with metadata, converting Uint8Array to blob URL for image rendering.
frontend/src/pages/PlaylistDetail.tsx: Empty file placeholder for playlist detail page functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Playlists.tsx: Empty file placeholder for playlists page functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: User settings page for managing profile information, channel name, and displaying subscription status with premium badge indicators.
frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx: Premium subscription upgrade page displaying free vs premium tier comparison with feature lists and upgrade action button.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPhoto.tsx: React component for uploading photos with authentication check, file preview, form inputs (title/description), upload progress tracking, and success/error states. Includes UpgradePrompt component integration.
frontend/src/pages/UploadVideo.tsx: React component for uploading videos with file validation (format/size limits), thumbnail selection after upload, progress tracking, and retry/upload-another functionality. Validates MP4/WebM/OGG formats up to 500MB.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGallery.tsx: React component displaying a grid of video cards with debounced search functionality that filters videos by title or description. Shows loading states and empty states for no videos or no search results.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx: React component for playing videos with like/subscribe functionality, view count tracking, expandable description, share button, edit modal for owners, and related videos sidebar. Uses ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() for video streaming.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions for formatting view counts (0, 1.2K, 3.5M, etc.) and timestamps into relative time strings (e.g., '2 hours ago', '3 days ago').
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme with sidebar/chart colors, custom border radius variables, Inter font family, and accordion animation keyframes.
project_state.json: Project state tracking for a YouTube-style video platform with existing features including video player page, metadata display, subscribe button, expandable description, comments section, and related videos sidebar.
